scheme_name: DST Inspire Faculty Award & Research Grant
overview: The DST Inspire Faculty Award & Research Grant is a component of the INSPIRE programme sponsored by the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India, aimed at attracting talent to science and strengthening the Science & Technology system and R&D base. It offers contractual research fellowships to young achievers with Ph.D. degrees for independent research, with the goal of emerging as future leaders in science & technology. The scheme includes a monthly fellowship amount and an annual research grant, and is tenable for a maximum period of five years.
target_beneficiaries: people of Indian origin including NRI/PIO
objectives: Attract talent to the study of science at an early age
Build the required critical human resource pool for strengthening and expanding the Science & Technology system and R&D base
Offer contractual research fellowships to young achievers for independent research
Provide opportunity for independent research in the near term to emerge as future leaders in science & technology
eligibility: Indian citizens and people of Indian origin including NRI/PIO status with Ph.D. (in Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Pharmacy, Medicine, and Agriculture related subjects) from any recognized university in the world. Those applicants who apply by choosing the new subject area ‘Translational Research in S&T’ need to have at least two patents filed or one patent granted to their credit. Those who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis and are awaiting award of the degree are also eligible. However, the Fellowship will be conveyed only after confirmation of award of the Ph.D. degree.
benefits: Faculty fellowship amount is Rs. 1,25,000/- per month with an annual increment of Rs. 2000/- and Research Grant of Rs. 7,00,000/- per year for 5 years’ period. The fellowship amount is consolidated (all inclusive). No break-up will be provided by DST. Selected fellow must submit two undertakings: a) Duly signed 'Undertaking by INSPIRE Faculty Fellow' and b) Undertaking duly signed by both the competent authority from the chosen Host institution and the INSPIRE Faculty Fellow. Bank account detail of the Host Institute, Joining Report, and Budget breakup on usage of Research Grant are required for receiving the first instalment grant.
financial_support: Faculty fellowship amount is Rs. 1,25,000/- per month with an annual increment of Rs. 2000/- and Research Grant of Rs. 7,00,000/- per year for 5 years’ period. The Research Grant of Rs.7.0 lakh per year can be utilized for expenditures under recurring and non-recurring budget subheads flexibly. The fellow has inter-operational flexibility to use the research grant in other budget subheads other than the subhead of Travel, Contingency and overhead. However, Expenditure under Travel and Contingencies subheads will be limited to 10% each (Rs. 70,000/- per year) and Overhead 5% (Rs. 35,  per year). As per the new fund flow mechanism initiated by the government w.e.f. 2024-2025 i.e. Hybrid-TSA Model grant provided to INSPIRE Faculty Fellows should be utilized within the same financial year in which it has been released. There is no provision of carry forwarding of unspent Research Grant to next financial year.
grant_amount_per_entity: Rs. 1,25,000/- per month with an annual increment of Rs. 2000/- and Research Grant of Rs. 7,00,000/- per year
application_process: 1. Call for applications are advertised once in a year in the month of July/Aug on the online portal. 2. One can apply for the Faculty Fellowship through online portal only. 3. To apply online, please follow the link https://www.online-inspire.gov.in. 4. Selected candidates should avail the INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship within 3 months of issue of offer letter. 5. Selected fellow must submit two undertakings: a) Duly signed 'Undertaking by INSPIRE Faculty Fellow' and b) Undertaking duly signed by both the competent authority from the chosen Host institution and the INSPIRE Faculty Fellow. 6. Bank account detail of the Host Institute, Joining Report, and Budget breakup on usage of Research Grant are required for receiving the first instalment grant.
required_documents: Bank account detail of the Host Institute
Undertaking signed by the Faculty Fellow
Undertaking signed by the Faculty Fellow and Host Institute
Budget breakup on usage of Research Grant
deadlines: Call for applications are advertised once in a year in the month of July/Aug on the online portal.
implementing_agency: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India
caveats: The INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship is tenable for a maximum period of 5 (five) years and no further extension will be given as per existing rules.
Under no circumstances the 'INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship' is renewable after 5 years.
When a fellow joins a regular position during the Fellowship tenure of 5 years, the fellowship shall be discontinued from the day he/she joins the regular position.

The Research Grant of Rs.7,00,000/- per year will be carry-forwarded (i.e. unspent balance amount) to next year: As per the new fund flow mechanism initiated by the government w.e.f. 2024-2025 i.e. Hybrid-TSA Model grant provided to INSPIRE Faculty Fellows should be utilized within the same financial year in which it has been released. There is no provision of carry forwarding of unspent Research Grant to next financial year.
